Game Overview

In Skate Xmas, the core idea is straightforward: experience the thrill of rooftop skateboarding amidst the festive vibrancy of Christmas. Navigate your board with precision, leaping between buildings while dodging airborne obstacles. Balance is key; a slip can send you plummeting. Embrace the challenge and enjoy the exhilarating journey to the finish line!
